description: This file contains the LoanTransactionRelationReadService class, which provides methods to fetch loan transaction relation data from the database using JPA Criteria API. It interacts with LoanTransactionRelation entities and maps them to data transfer objects.

classes.name: LoanTransactionRelationReadService
classes.description: Service class for reading LoanTransactionRelation data from the database, using JPA criteria queries, and mapping entities to data transfer objects.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionRelationDataFrom(Long)
methods.description: Fetches a list of LoanTransactionRelationData objects related to a single transaction ID.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionRelationDataFrom(List<Long>)
methods.description: Fetches a list of LoanTransactionRelationData objects related to multiple transaction IDs.

methods.name: fetchLoanTransactionRelationFrom(List<Long>)
methods.description: Fetches a list of LoanTransactionRelation entities from the database based on provided transaction IDs using JPA criteria API.
